title: SDC's sale to Netcompany shows the Nordic cooperative model consolidating
content:
SDC was a member-bank-owned Danish cooperative and has been sold to Netcompany. That removes it as an independent lead — the ownership structure that made it interesting no longer exists — and it places it inside a firm the research elsewhere reads as the closest competitor rather than a channel.

The wider reading the record draws is that the cooperative model is consolidating. Several Danish bank-owned cooperatives appear in this lead set as a distinct structural category, and one of them has now been acquired by a large bespoke-build integrator. If that direction continues, the window for engaging owner-controlled Nordic financial IT is narrowing rather than stable.

Its stack was not researched. The entry is kept for the pattern rather than for the prospect, at priority 4.
